title: Open Balances and Recent Credits Carried into an Approved-Case Advance
content:
**Rule.** For an advance toward the coming month on an approved case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, the case balance is added to the advance as follows: where the case's patient pay balance is owed, that balance is added, since the payment is applied to the open months first; where the balance is a credit and a reduction was posted on the case within the refund days, the credit is subtracted, but never more than the patient pay the coming month will carry; otherwise, including a credit with no reduction posted within the refund days, which is owed back as a refund, nothing is carried. The case's patient pay balance is the patient pay charges and refunds on the case less the payments and reductions posted to it.

**Refunds and this payment.** A patient pay credit balance is refunded within the refund days, to the resident or representative, or to the estate after a death; when the representative of an approved case pays toward the coming month while a credit that arose from a reduction posted within the refund days stands on the case, that credit is instead applied to the coming month up to the patient pay the coming month will carry, and only for such a payment; a payment toward a coming pending month takes the rule for pending cases, and every other credit balance is refunded under the base rule.

The refund days are 30 calendar days: a reduction is within them when its posting date is no more than 30 days before today — the latest reduction on the case is the one read.

| Case patient pay balance | Latest reduction posted on the case | Carried into the advance |
|---|---|---|
| owed (above zero) | any | the owed balance is added |
| credit (below zero) | 30 days ago or less | the credit is subtracted, at most the patient pay the coming month will carry |
| credit (below zero) | 31 days ago or more, or none | nothing (the credit is owed back as a refund) |
| zero | any | nothing |

*Hypothetical:* the coming month will carry 1,276.90 dollars. An owed balance of 214.35 dollars adds 214.35. A credit of 160.20 dollars from a reduction posted 9 days ago subtracts 160.20; a credit of 1,500.00 dollars from such a reduction subtracts only 1,276.90. A credit of 160.20 dollars whose latest reduction was posted 45 days ago carries nothing.
